messages:
Sofia Patel: Kicking off HelixMed onboarding. Primary goals: HIPAA-readiness checklist complete, Day30 pilot with 50 clinicians, <3% inference error rate, and usage dashboard for clinical ops. Propose standing syncs Thursdays 9am PT.
Ethan Rivera: Adding HelixMed stakeholders: Dir of Product (Lena), Security lead (Omar), Cloud infra (Priyanka). I'll intro them after this thread and share stakeholder RACI.
Claire Huang: Proposed technical timeline: Week0: creds + SAML exchange, Week1: staging integration + smoke tests, Week2: end-to-end clinical flow tests, Week3: performance tuning & canary, Week4: pilot go-live. Need staging VPC peering and artifact access.
Diego Alvarez: Risks: EU patient data subset might require in-region processing. Also HelixMed needs HSM integration for keys. Blocking items: SAML metadata, corp firewall allowlist, and model provenance doc.
Nora Singh: Enablement: 2 x instructor-led sessions (Clinician workflows & Admin ops) and a sandbox lab. Recommend clinician session in Week3 (pre-pilot) and admin ops in Week2. I'll prepare a one-page runbook + short checklist for triage.
Sofia Patel: Success metrics tied to renewal: pilot adoption >=40% of target clinicians by Day45, <5 critical incidents, and completion of security attestation. If metrics missed, trigger AM escalation and 2-week adoption sprint.
Ethan Rivera: Feedback plan: weekly 5-min pulse embedded in the clinician UI (opt-in) + biweekly 20-min PM interview. We'll instrument events for conversion funnel: invite -> activate -> first 3 uses.
Claire Huang: Dev snippet to validate endpoint (share with Helix devs once creds ready):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize note: patient vitals"}] }'
```
Diego Alvarez: I'll add a short k6 script for a 30s ramp to check autoscaling and batching. Also drafting a dataflow map to ensure PHI stays inside allowed regions.
onboard-bot: Created project folder https://redwood.link/helixmed-onboard and scheduled weekly invites (Thu 9am PT). Checklist and templates added. React with :white_check_mark: when you reviewed.
Nora Singh: I'll produce the clinician-facing quickstart and a <2min explainer clip for training.
Sofia Patel: Next steps: Ethan to intro stakeholders, Claire to confirm staging ETA (aiming Tue), Diego to drop SAML checklist, Nora to publish enablement dates. Call out any critical blockers by EOD.
Ethan Rivera: Intro prep in 10m, will loop in Lena and Omar.
Claire Huang: Staging creds ETA: Tues EOD if access request approved.
Diego Alvarez: Will post SAML checklist and k6 job by EOD.
Nora Singh: Scheduling enablement sessions for Week2/Week3, will share calendar links.
Sofia Patel: Thanks team 44D tagging this thread as kickoff acknowledged once intros are in.
